finals.race: PricedUp Bet Gordon Richards Novices' Limited Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
finals.comment: Free-going sort early in his career but looked more professional when gaining a first handicap success at Huntingdon (2m) in December. Rare poor effort in first-time cheekpieces when eighteenth of 21 in handicap hurdle at Punchestown (17f, good to soft) in April. Much respected on chase debut.

finals.race: PricedUp Boosts And BOG Cumberland Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
finals.comment: Aintree reappearance success last Christmas shows he goes well fresh. Ended his campaign with a creditable fourth of 19 in handicap at Punchestown (31f, good) in May. Only 2 lb above the mark he defied at Aintree.

finals.race: PricedUp Bet Open NH Flat Race (GBB Race)
finals.comment: €25,000 3-y-o, £140,000 4-y-o, Old Persian gelding. Dam unraced half-sister to useful hurdler/chaser (stayed 3m) Jarveys Plate. Yard's newcomers always respected.
Has shown little to be enthused about of late, both over hurdles and on the Flat. Dropped to last winning mark as a result but requires a big leap of faith.

Improving handicapper with fine record on heavy ground at this track. Only denied by promising Storm Ready on return from a break at Naas (7f, soft) last month but well held in a listed event at Leopardstown since.

Went close in 3-y-o handicaps at Fairyhouse/Limerick in first half of this season and capitalised on a much reduced mark to land a gamble/open his account at Gowran (7f, soft) last time. Not an obvious one to follow up back in a higher grade.

finals.race: Velo Coffee At The Curragh Maiden
finals.comment: Pulled up in maiden over C&D (soft, 150/1) on debut 17 days ago.

finals.race: CopyBet For Football Profit Boosts Novices' Hurdle (GBB Race)
finals.comment: Made a winning debut in a Huntingdon bumper and has since shown fair form without scoring on the Flat this summer. Went too freely on his hurdling debut when a well-held fourth of 5 in novice at Plumpton (2m, good) 13 days ago. Could take a big step forward though now fitted with a hood.

finals.race: CopyBet Proudly Backs UK Horse Racing Novices' Limited Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
finals.comment: Multiple point winner who shaped like a stayer in 3 starts over hurdles. Well supported but proved somewhat disappointing on chasing bow at Uttoxeter last month, but it's still early days and his yard boasts an excellent strike rate with their runners at this venue. Better to come.

finals.race: CopyBet Overnight Best Odds Guaranteed Handicap Hurdle
finals.comment: Much improved sent handicapping in cheekpieces, following up her Ffos Las win (2½m) with an all-the-way success at Bangor (23f) in May. Good effort in defeat when third at Uttoxeter in July, before shaping as if amiss at Fontwell the following month. Worth another chance after a break.

finals.race: CopyBet For Premier League Profit Boosts Novices' Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
finals.comment: Irish point winner who made encouraging start under Rules earlier this year, making the frame in maidens at Wincanton and Bangor. Not at same level on final outing at Ffos Las but looks on a fair mark for his handicap chase debut and his yard remains in fine form.

finals.race: CopyBet Pay First Past The Post Novices' Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
finals.comment: Scored for the second time over hurdles when convincingly winning 11-runner novice hurdle at Hexham (2m, good to soft) in April. 2 lb lower back in a handicap so rates as a leading player making chase debut.

finals.race: CopyBet Follow Us On X Maiden Hurdle (GBB Race)
finals.comment: €37,000 3-y-o, Maxios gelding. Closely related to French 1½m winner Jeejeebhoy. Unplaced only start in Irish points (Mar 22). Betting can guide expectations.

finals.race: PricedUp Now With Best Odds Guaranteed Novices' Hurdle (GBB Race)
finals.comment: €20,000 3-y-o, £60,000 5-y-o, Crystal Ocean gelding. Half-brother to fair hurdler/useful chase winner El Capitaine, stays 25f. Won sole start in Irish points earlier this year and newcomers from yard are often fancied.

Further progress this year, winning at Leopardstown in April before looking rather unlucky in a big-field handicap at Glorious Goodwood. Quickly back on track when beaten only by a very smart prospect in listed race at Leopardstown 2 weeks ago and he remains of interest off his current mark.

finals.race: CopyBet Overnight Best Odds Guaranteed Novices' Handicap Hurdle
finals.comment: Lightly-raced 7-y-o. Showed improved form amid a lack of professionalism (wandered badly) when 1¼-length second in a thin Uttoxeter handicap (2½m) in May. In-form yard has had several runners ready to roll in recent weeks. Another step forward could see her in the mix here.

dropped.race: PricedUp Bet Open NH Flat Race (GBB Race)
dropped.comment: €12,000 3-y-o, £55,000 4-y-o, Tirwanako gelding. Dam unraced. Definitely merits a second look on debut given connections.

dropped.race: CopyBet For Football Profit Boosts Novices' Hurdle (GBB Race)
dropped.comment: Fair Flat winner (stays 1½m) but he has yet to offer much on both his runs over hurdles, coming in a well-held sixth of 8 in novice hurdle at Market Rasen (17f, good to soft) 15 days ago. In very good hands so could still do better.
